pages.name: Home
pages.purpose: Win the 5-second first-impression test and establish Gochujang as a premium, flavor-forward culinary destination. A cinematic front door that instantly signals 'award-winning restaurant site meets food magazine,' then funnels new visitors into Explore (discovery) and returning cooks into Kitchen (their dashboard).
keySections: Sticky translucent GlobalNav with animated brand mark and a single high-contrast 'Start cooking' CTA

Full-bleed cinematic hero: generative SVG gradient art layer + duotone food image (Unsplash URL with palette gradient fallback) + grain overlay, kinetic staggered headline, one primary + one ghost CTA, subtle scroll cue
Live 'Flavor Pulse' marquee/ticker — trending dishes, cuisines and techniques scrolling as a horizontal band
Featured Dish spotlight — oversized editorial split-panel card linking to a Dish detail
Category glyph grid — cuisines & techniques rendered as committed local SVG glyphs (guaranteed render) with hover motion
Explore-by-flavor interactive band — flavor-wheel / mood chips that deep-link into pre-filtered /explore
Kitchen teaser — animated preview of the reinvented tracker (streak flame, live batch progress ring, stat tiles) to make tracking feel desirable
Editorial story rail — horizontally-scrolling magazine features / collections carousel
Social-proof band — pull-quotes from home cooks + press logos on a grain-textured surface
Newsletter / join CTA with generative gradient background
Footer — sitemap, brand statement, category links, credits, theme toggle

pages.name: Explore
pages.purpose: The high-graphic discovery engine — let design-conscious food lovers browse the full dish catalog and drill into any flavor, cuisine, technique, spice level or mood through a beautiful, fast, filterable mosaic. This is the primary catalog surface and the top of the cook funnel.
keySections: Compact page header — eyebrow + title + live result count + view toggle (mosaic / list)
Sticky FilterBar — cuisine, flavor profile, spice/heat, technique, time, difficulty, dietary; collapses into a floating filter FAB on mobile
Active-filter chip row with one-tap clear-all
Editorial mosaic grid — masonry DishCards with duotone overlay, gradient fallback, hover parallax and quick-look affordance
Interspersed featured collection bands (e.g. 'Fermented & Funky', 'Weeknight Fire') breaking the grid rhythm
QuickLook modal — peek at a dish without leaving the grid (image, spice meter, key stats, open/save/wishlist)
Infinite scroll / load-more with skeleton-shimmer placeholders
Illustrated empty state for zero-result filter combos with a 'reset' nudge
Back-to-top control + persistent mobile filter FAB

pages.name: Dish Detail
pages.purpose: An immersive, magazine-grade single-dish page that both tells the dish's story beautifully and acts as the conversion point into the Kitchen — the place a visitor decides to cook it, log it, wishlist it, or start a fermentation/marinade batch.
keySections: Immersive hero — large duotone image (Unsplash + gradient fallback), dish title, cuisine tag, live SpiceMeter, aggregate rating
Sticky action bar — Cook it / Log this cook / Add to wishlist / Save / Share (persists on scroll)
At-a-glance stat strip — total time, difficulty, servings, heat band, primary flavor tags
FlavorRadar visualization — heat, umami, acidity, sweetness, funk, texture
Editorial intro — the story and POV behind the dish
Ingredients — scalable by servings, with pantry/substitution hints
Method — numbered steps with inline technique glyphs and timing chips
Fermentation/marinade callout (when applicable) — timing detail + 'Start a batch' CTA that seeds a Kitchen Batch
Pairings rail — drink/wine/side PairingCards
Tasting notes — community notes plus an inline entry point to add your own
Related dishes carousel
Log-this-dish CTA footer reinforcing the track action

pages.name: Kitchen (Mise)
pages.purpose: The reinvented tracker — 'Mise,' a personal culinary dashboard and living journal. Turns the old 'static, boring tracker' into a desirable, gamified command center where a food lover sees their streak, running fermentation/marinade batches, cook log, spice-tolerance progression, wishlist and cuisine passport at a glance.
keySections: Personalized hero header — greeting, avatar, kitchen title/level and an animated streak flame
Stat tiles row — dishes cooked, cuisines explored, active batches, current spice tolerance
Streak & activity heatmap — contribution-style calendar of cooking days with weekly goal
Active Batches board — fermentation/marinade/pickle timers as ProgressRings with ready-alerts
Recently Cooked feed — reverse-chron cook log with inline quick tasting-note entry
Spice Tolerance tracker — animated Scoville gauge with trend sparkline and next-tier badge
Wishlist / Want-to-Cook board — droppable cards you can plan onto dates
Flavor Passport — map/wheel of cuisines & techniques conquered with collected stamp glyphs
Achievements shelf — unlocked and in-progress badges
Insights panel — personal analytics: most-cooked cuisine, average rating, heat trend
Quick-add FAB — log a cook, start a batch, or drop a tasting note from anywhere on the page

pages.name: About
pages.purpose: Establish brand credibility and the bold, global, flavor-forward point of view behind the 'Gochujang' codename — the manifesto, the story, the curation standards and the invitation to join. Converts trust into newsletter signups and account creation.
keySections: Manifesto hero — a bold, opinionated statement of the Gochujang POV over generative brand art
Origin story — why 'Gochujang': fermentation, boldness, global-and-Korean-forward taste
Editorial values trio — the principles behind what gets featured
The Palette — brand philosophy on color, flavor and design as one language
Contributors / team grid with duotone portraits
Curation standards — how dishes are tested, rated and selected
Press & recognition band
Join CTA — newsletter + create-your-Kitchen invitation
Contact & footer

trackerConcept.name: Mise
trackerConcept.description: Mise (from mise en place) is the reinvented tracker living at /kitchen — a living culinary journal and personal dashboard, not a spreadsheet. Instead of a static list, it turns a food lover's real kitchen life into something graphic and desirable: an animated streak flame, fermentation and marinade batches ticking down on progress rings, a cook log you fill with one tap, a Scoville gauge that levels up as your palate gets braver, and a Flavor Passport that stamps every cuisine you conquer. Every dish page feeds into it, and every visit rewards you with visible progress — the anti-boring tracker that makes tracking feel like collecting.
features: One-tap Cook Log — 'I made this' straight from any Dish detail, with rating, photo and difficulty-felt
Fermentation & marinade Batch timers — progress rings, vessel/ingredient notes and ready-alerts for kimchi, hot sauce, brines and cures
Structured Tasting Notes journal — aroma, texture, heat, acidity, umami, balance and a verdict, not just a text blob
Spice Tolerance tracker — a personal Scoville gauge with trend sparkline that levels up as you log hotter dishes
Streaks & activity heatmap — contribution-style calendar with a weekly cooking goal and streak flame
Flavor Passport — a stamp-collecting map of every cuisine and technique you've cooked, with mastery levels
Wishlist / Want-to-Cook board — heart dishes anywhere, then drag them onto a plan-for date
Achievement badges & kitchen levels — tiered unlocks (First Ferment, Chili Head, Ten Cuisines) that gamify progress
Personal insights — most-cooked cuisine, average rating, heat-trend and cook-frequency analytics
Shareable cook cards — export a beautifully-designed card of a logged cook or batch result

userFlows.name: Discover to first logged cook (new-visitor funnel)
steps: Land on Home; cinematic hero and Flavor Pulse marquee win the 5-second test
Tap 'Explore' (or a flavor chip that deep-links a pre-filtered /explore)
Filter the mosaic by spice + 'fermented' and open a DishCard QuickLook
Open the full /dish/:id, read the story, FlavorRadar and method
Tap 'Cook it', then 'Log this cook' — set rating, servings and a quick tasting note
Prompted to 'Start a fermentation batch' from the dish's timing callout
Streak increments and a first-cook achievement unlocks, nudging the user to /kitchen (Mise)

userFlows.name: Start and track a fermentation batch
steps: On a /dish/:id with a fermentation callout, tap 'Start a batch'
Choose type (ferment/marinade/pickle), start date, duration, vessel and ingredient notes
Batch appears on the Kitchen Active Batches board as a live ProgressRing with a reminder set
Receive a ready-alert (Toast) when readyAt is reached
Mark the batch 'consumed', log a TastingNote with heat/balance/verdict and a result rating
Batch result feeds Insights and may unlock a 'First Ferment' badge

userFlows.name: Build a wishlist and plan a cooking week
steps: While browsing /explore or a /dish/:id, heart dishes to add WishlistItems
Open /kitchen and go to the Want-to-Cook board
Drag wishlist cards onto plan-for dates (status want -> planned)
Cook a planned dish and log it from the card or the dish page
Item moves planned -> cooked, the Streak heatmap fills, and the Flavor Passport gains a new cuisine stamp
Insights panel updates most-cooked cuisine and average rating
